pages.text: $(l)Legs$() that walk: Hydraulic Legs (set the Stride), Arachnid Legs (climb walls), Stilts (2-block steps), Hover Skirt (over water and lava), Lava Treads. Spring Heels, Sprint Servos, Aqua Fins and Anchor Clamps do not walk: only the Kite can use them.

$(l)Core$(): Galvanic Stack, Capacitor Bank; the Combustion Kernel, Bio-Reactor Core and Fusion Bottle burn fuel from the Cargo Hold.$(br2)Signal Booster and Bio-Scanner: fitted, they only draw power for now.
